verified_claims.claim: Required statement: "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases." (Operating Agreement §5)
verified_claims.source_title: Amazon.com Associates Program Operating Agreement (Updated October 15, 2025)

verified_claims.claim: Special Links must properly use the special "tagged" link formats and comply with the Agreement (OA §1)
Associates ID / "tag" appears as XXXXX-## or such other format as designated (Participation Requirements §2(b))
Session = 24h / order / another Special Link; cart orders qualify if completed within 89 days of the click (Commission Income Statement §1)
Purchases not correctly tracked because links are improperly formatted are disqualified (Commission Income Statement §2(g))
Prices may only be shown if served by the link or obtained via Creators API/PA API with timestamp and prescribed disclaimer (IP License §2(i)-(k); Participation Requirements §2(b))
Customer star ratings/reviews may not be displayed unless obtained through Creators API or PA API (Participation Requirements §6(t))
Link shorteners must not make it unclear that you are linking to an Amazon Site (Participation Requirements §6(w))
The commission rate schedule (Appendix) requires Associates sign-in; rates not publicly verifiable
verified_claims.source_title: Amazon Associates Commission Income Statement schedule (redirects to sign-in)

verified_claims.claim: "clear and conspicuous" = "difficult to miss (i.e., easily noticeable) and easily understandable by ordinary consumers"; on the internet the disclosure "should be unavoidable" (16 CFR §255.0(f))
Material connections must be disclosed clearly and conspicuously; Endorsement Guides revised 2023 (88 FR 48102, July 26, 2023)
verified_claims.source_title: FTC's Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking

verified_claims.claim: "An ASIN is always 10 characters long, and either entirely numeric … or starts with a 'B'"
verified_claims.source_title: Amazon Ads: A guide to targeting with Sponsored Products
